1|# Install Expertery v0
2|
3|Expertery v0 is a command-line product a company installs into its OWN
4|Modal cloud account: its past work, exams and trained model stay in
5|that account. v0 supports one tool: CadQuery CAD.
6|
7|## Install
8|
9|Needs Python 3.12+, `uv`, and `modal` (run `modal setup` first).
10|
11|```sh
12|./install.sh
13|expertery init
14|```
15|
16|`install.sh` checks `uv` and `modal` exist, runs
17|`uv tool install --editable "<repo dir>"`, then prints the next step
18|(`expertery init`). It never asks for or prints secrets.
19|
20|`expertery init` checks the Modal token works (`modal profile
21|current`), reports whether a reader key is configured
22|(`EXPERTERY_READER_KEY`, falling back to `BASETEN_API_KEY`;
23|present/missing only, values are never printed), deploys the CAD box +
24|grader apps (the same deploy `experiments/final/cloud_cq.py` defines)
25|into the current Modal account, and writes
26|`~/.expertery/config.json` (tool `cadquery`; reader url/model
27|defaults from the factory teacher, overridable via
28|`EXPERTERY_READER_URL` / `EXPERTERY_READER_MODEL` so a company can
29|point at its own Spark Open or Glimmer server).
30|
31|## Privacy model (what runs where)
32|
33|- Past work, exams and the trained model live in the company's own
34|  Modal account. Nothing leaves it except reader API calls.
35|- Reader calls (Meta Muse Spark Open by default, or the company's own
36|  server via `EXPERTERY_READER_URL`) see ONLY the request text, plus
37|  the reference part's measurements in the explainer call. They NEVER
38|  see reference code (`part.py` is only built in the company's cloud
39|  box and graded by its cloud grader).
40|- Reference programs are trusted company code and build inside the
41|  locked cloud box; model answers always run in a fresh locked
42|  sandbox, never on a laptop.
43|
44|## Commands
45|
46|All examples assume the demo past work in `examples/past-work-brackets`
47|(one folder per job: `request.txt` + `part.py`).
48|
49|```sh
50|# 1. Turn past work into exam candidates ($ cap required).
51|expertery exam build examples/past-work-brackets --out results/my-exam \
52|  --cap-dollars 5 --readers 2 --workers 4
53|
54|# 2. Decide every FLAGGED job (accept / keep / drop / edit).
55|expertery exam review results/my-exam
56|expertery exam review results/my-exam --accept-all   # scripts/tests
57|
58|# 3. Lock the exam (writes exam.jsonl + FREEZE.txt).
59|expertery exam lock results/my-exam
60|
61|# 4. Run the exam on the trained or the base model ($ cap required).
62|expertery test --exam results/my-exam/exam.jsonl --model trained \
63|  --name final --out results/my-run --cap-dollars 5 --k 3
64|expertery test --exam results/my-exam/exam.jsonl --model base \
65|  --name base --out results/my-run-base --cap-dollars 5 --loop
66|
67|# 5. Serve the trained model.
68|expertery serve --name final
69|
70|# 6. Train on practice records ($ cap required; guarded entrypoint,
71|#    never `modal run ...::train`). Practice data in v0 comes from
72|#    the factory scripts (experiments/factory, experiments/r5).
73|expertery train --data train_records.jsonl --out my-model --cap-dollars 20
74|
75|# 7. Config, Modal apps, latest exam dirs.
76|expertery status
77|```
78|
79|Every command that can spend money takes `--cap-dollars` (required,
80|> 0) and `--dry-run` (prints the plan and the estimated spend, spends
81|nothing). Money: each model call is costed from its tokens with the
82|teacher's price constants; no new calls start once the next could
83|pass the cap; `spent_estimate` is written to the output.
84|
85|`exam review` accepts `--accept-all` / `--keep-all` for scripts and
86|tests (recorded with reviewer `"flag"`). Accepted or edited texts are
87|NOT re-checked automatically; `report.md` says to re-run
88|`exam build` on edited jobs to re-check them.
89|
90|## Honest limits (v0)
91|
92|- CadQuery only. `part.step` files are marked SKIPPED (not supported).
93|- Practice-job generation still uses the factory scripts
94|  (`experiments/factory`, `experiments/r5`); train/serve need GPU
95|  money in the user's own account.
96|- `exam build` refuses to overwrite an exam dir that has `exam.jsonl`;
97|  `exam lock` refuses while any FLAGGED job has no decision, and while
98|  any DEFERRED job (cap stopped new calls) is unfinished.
99|- A FLAGGED job is not a model failure: the wording may be read two
100|  ways. A person decides.

1|"""Exam build / review / lock for one tool (v0: CadQuery).
2|
3|Past work = one folder per job: request.txt + part.py (CadQuery code
4|defining `result`). A part.step file means "not supported in v0": the
5|job is marked SKIPPED.
6|
7|All cloud contact goes through injected callables so tests run offline:
8|- box_fn(code) -> {"brep_bytes", "measure", "log", "run_error"}.
9|- grade_fn(exam, job_id, brep) -> grader dict with at least "verdict".
10|  The reference (part.py source) travels with the jobs list given to
11|  cloud.factory_grade_fn, exactly as runner_final.grade_fn_for does, so
12|  new past-work ids grade against their own reference at the 0.2% rule.
13|- post_fn(body) -> parsed chat-completions JSON for one reader call.
14|
15|Money: every model call is costed from its usage tokens with the
16|teacher's price constants (config fallbacks). Before starting a new
17|call, spent_estimate + one in-flight reserve must still fit the cap;
18|otherwise no new calls start. spent_estimate is written to the output.
19|"""

125|class Budget:
126|    """Cap guard: stop starting new calls when the next could pass."""
127|
128|    def __init__(self, cap_dollars):
129|        if not cap_dollars > 0:
130|            raise ExamError("--cap-dollars must be > 0")
131|        self.cap = float(cap_dollars)
132|        self.spent = 0.0
133|        self.reserve = _cloud.in_flight_cost()
134|        self.lock = threading.Lock()

136|    def may_start(self):
137|        """True when one more call still fits inside the cap."""
138|        with self.lock:
139|            return self.spent + self.reserve <= self.cap

141|    def charge(self, cost):
142|        """Add the realised cost of a finished call."""
143|        with self.lock:
144|            self.spent += max(0.0, float(cost))

1|# Install Expertery v0
2|
3|Expertery v0 is a command-line product a company installs into its OWN
4|Modal cloud account: its past work, exams and trained model stay in
5|that account. v0 supports one tool: CadQuery CAD.
6|
7|## Install
8|
9|Needs Python 3.12+, `uv`, and `modal` (run `modal setup` first).
10|
11|```sh
12|./install.sh
13|expertery init
14|```
15|
16|`install.sh` checks `uv` and `modal` exist, runs
17|`uv tool install --editable "<repo dir>"`, then prints the next step
18|(`expertery init`). It never asks for or prints secrets.
19|
20|`expertery init` checks the Modal token works (`modal profile
21|current`), reports whether a reader key is configured
22|(`EXPERTERY_READER_KEY`, falling back to `BASETEN_API_KEY`;
23|present/missing only, values are never printed), deploys the CAD box +
24|grader apps (the same deploy `experiments/final/cloud_cq.py` defines)
25|into the current Modal account, and writes
26|`~/.expertery/config.json` (tool `cadquery`; reader url/model
27|defaults from the factory teacher, overridable via
28|`EXPERTERY_READER_URL` / `EXPERTERY_READER_MODEL` so a company can
29|point at its own Spark Open or Glimmer server).
30|
31|## Privacy model (what runs where)
32|
33|- Past work, exams and the trained model live in the company's own
34|  Modal account. Nothing leaves it except reader API calls.
35|- Reader calls (Meta Muse Spark Open by default, or the company's own
36|  server via `EXPERTERY_READER_URL`) see ONLY the request text, plus
37|  the reference part's measurements in the explainer call. They NEVER
38|  see reference code (`part.py` is only built in the company's cloud
39|  box and graded by its cloud grader).
40|- Reference programs are trusted company code and build inside the
41|  locked cloud box; model answers always run in a fresh locked
42|  sandbox, never on a laptop.
43|
44|## Commands
45|
46|All examples assume the demo past work in `examples/past-work-brackets`
47|(one folder per job: `request.txt` + `part.py`).
48|
49|```sh
50|# 1. Turn past work into exam candidates ($ cap required).
51|expertery exam build examples/past-work-brackets --out results/my-exam \
52|  --cap-dollars 5 --readers 2 --workers 4
53|
54|# 2. Decide every FLAGGED job (accept / keep / drop / edit).
55|expertery exam review results/my-exam
56|expertery exam review results/my-exam --accept-all   # scripts/tests
57|
58|# 3. Lock the exam (writes exam.jsonl + FREEZE.txt).
59|expertery exam lock results/my-exam
60|
61|# 4. Run the exam on the trained or the base model ($ cap required).
62|expertery test --exam results/my-exam/exam.jsonl --model trained \
63|  --name final --out results/my-run --cap-dollars 5 --k 3
64|expertery test --exam results/my-exam/exam.jsonl --model base \
65|  --name base --out results/my-run-base --cap-dollars 5 --loop
66|
67|# 5. Serve the trained model.
68|expertery serve --name final
69|
70|# 6. Train on practice records ($ cap required; guarded entrypoint,
71|#    never `modal run ...::train`). Practice data in v0 comes from
72|#    the factory scripts (experiments/factory, experiments/r5).
73|expertery train --data train_records.jsonl --out my-model --cap-dollars 20
74|
75|# 7. Config, Modal apps, latest exam dirs.
76|expertery status
77|```
78|
79|Every command that can spend money takes `--cap-dollars` (required,
80|> 0) and `--dry-run` (prints the plan and the estimated spend, spends
81|nothing). Money: each model call is costed from its tokens with the
82|teacher's price constants; no new calls start once the next could
83|pass the cap; `spent_estimate` is written to the output.
84|
85|`exam review` accepts `--accept-all` / `--keep-all` for scripts and
86|tests (recorded with reviewer `"flag"`). Accepted or edited texts are
87|NOT re-checked automatically; `report.md` says to re-run
88|`exam build` on edited jobs to re-check them.
89|
90|## Honest limits (v0)
91|
92|- CadQuery only. `part.step` files are marked SKIPPED (not supported).
93|- Practice-job generation still uses the factory scripts
94|  (`experiments/factory`, `experiments/r5`); train/serve need GPU
95|  money in the user's own account.
96|- `exam build` refuses to overwrite an exam dir that has `exam.jsonl`;
97|  `exam lock` refuses while any FLAGGED job has no decision, and while
98|  any DEFERRED job (cap stopped new calls) is unfinished.
99|- A FLAGGED job is not a model failure: the wording may be read two
100|  ways. A person decides.
